name: adamjali
description: Practical Claude Code skills: deep-dive research & teardowns, web build/deploy, image search, repo audit, disk cleanup, outreach, and a skill generator.

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Deep-dive explanation & competitor/product teardown — parallel research, browser recon, reverse-engineer calculators to validated code.

plugins.name: jina-image-search
plugins.description: Find and scrape web images via Jina AI (search + reader). Bring your own free JINA_API_KEY; Reader also works keyless.

plugins.name: site-forge
plugins.description: Build a distinctive, production-grade website (and optional Remotion promo video) for any business, product, or person, then deploy it free.

plugins.name: disk-cleanup
plugins.description: Free up disk space on macOS safely — regenerable caches, old runtimes, and bulky artifacts with a green/yellow/red preview gate that never touches credentials or active code.

plugins.name: site-prospector
plugins.description: Find local businesses worth pitching a free demo website, verify the facts, build & deploy via site-forge, and draft tailored outreach — logged to a bounded ledger.

plugins.name: github-audit
plugins.description: Audit GitHub repo health (security, CI/CD, branch protection, dependencies, community), auto-fix safe issues behind saved policies, run quality gates, and ship behind a confirmation gate.

plugins.name: skill-maker
plugins.description: Create new Claude Code skills or slash-commands in a clean, consistent house style — XML phases, state files, saved rules, checkpoint resumption, and 14 compaction patterns.

plugins.name: cold-outreach
plugins.description: Research a prospect, evaluate fit, draft a personalized cold email, preview it to yourself, send via Resend, and track it in a bounded ledger. Config-driven across industries.

plugins.name: email-broadcasts
plugins.description: Draft, test, and send marketing / product-update email broadcasts to an audience via Resend — mandatory test-send and explicit confirmation, CAN-SPAM compliant, bounded history.
